'''Tsuchimikado Hisanaga''' (土御門 久脩) was a {{ill|Kugyō|es|Kugyō|fa|کوگیو|fr|Kugyō|ja|公卿|ko|공경|sh|Kugyō|zh|公卿|qid=Q3138036}} (court noble) and {{ill|Onmyōji|fa|اونمیو-جی|ja|陰陽師|ko|음양사|vi|Âm Dương sư|zh|陰陽師|zh_yue|陰陽師|qid=Q2274163|lt=Onmyōji}} who lived during the {{ill|Azuchi–Momoyama period|en|Azuchi–Momoyama period|qid=Q319531|lt=Azuchi–Momoyama period}} and the early {{ill|Edo period|ar|فترة إيدو|ast|Periodu Edo|az|Edo dövrü|bcl|Panahon nin Edo|be|Перыяд Эда|bg|Едо (период)|bn|এদো যুগ|bo|ཨེ་དོའི་དུས་སྐབས།|br|Marevezh Edo|ca|Període Edo|ckb|سەردەمی ئێدۆ|cs|Období Edo|cv|Эдо тапхăрĕ|da|Edo-perioden|de|Edo-Zeit|eo|Epoko de Edo|es|Período Edo|et|Edo ajastu|eu|Edo aroa|fa|دوره ادو|fi|Edo-kausi|fr|Époque d'Edo|gl|Período Edo|he|תקופת אדו|hi|एदो अवधी|hr|Edo (razdoblje)|hu|Edo-kor|id|Zaman Edo|is|Jedótímabilið|it|Periodo Edo|ja|江戸時代|jv|Jaman Édo|ko|에도 시대|lt|Edo laikotarpis|lv|Edo periods|mk|Едо (период)|mn|Эдогийн эрин|ms|Zaman Edo|nl|Edoperiode|nn|Edotida|oc|Periòde Edo|pl|Edo (okres)|pt|Período Edo|ro|Perioada Edo|ru|Период Эдо|simple|Edo period|sk|Obdobie Edo|sl|Obdobje Edo|sq|Periudha Edo|sr|Едо период|su|Période Edo|sv|Edoperioden|th|ยุคเอโดะ|tl|Panahong Edo|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Eto|tr|Edo Dönemi|uk|Період Едо|ur|ایڈو دور|uz|Edo davri|vi|Thời kỳ Edo|war|Panahon Edo|wuu|江戶時代|zh|江户时代|zh_min_nan|Edo sî-tāi|zh_yue|江戶時代|qid=Q184963|lt=Edo period}}. He was the son of {{ill|Tsuchimikado Arinaga|ja|土御門有脩|qid=Q11423481}}, the head of the {{ill|Yin-Yang Bureau|ja|陰陽寮}}. Hisanaga attained the Rank of {{ill|Junior Third Rank|ja|従三位}} and held positions such as {{ill|Hisanagi|ja|非参議|lt=Hisanagi}} and {{ill|Yin-Yang Bureau|ja|陰陽頭|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Head of the Onmyōryō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11658275}}.

== Biography ==

=== Early Life ===
Tsuchimikado Hisanaga was educated in {{ill|Tenmondō (astrology)|ja|天文道|lt=Tenmondō|qq= (astrology)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenmondō|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenmondō (astrology)}} (astronomy) and {{ill|Rekidō|ja|暦道|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rekidō|13=User:Immanuelle/Rekidō}} (calendar science) from a young age. In {{ill|Genki (era)|en|Genki (era)|qid=Q1145064|lt=Genki}} 3 (1572), he came of age. At 14 years old, he was appointed as {{ill|Yin-Yang Bureau|ja|陰陽頭|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Head of the Onmyōryō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11658275}} on {{ill|December 28, 1573|ja|天正元年12月28日}}.

=== Adoption into Kadenokōji Family ===
Hisanaga was briefly adopted into the {{ill|Kadenokōji family|ja|勘解由小路家}} as the family lacked an heir. However, after the death of his father in {{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|en|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|qid=Q1145058|lt=Tenshō Era}} 5 (1577), he returned to the {{ill|Tsuchimikado clan|ja|土御門家|lt=Tsuchimikado family}} and resumed his birthright.

=== Service and Achievements ===
Hisanaga served under leaders such as {{ill|Oda Nobunaga|en|Oda Nobunaga|qid=Q171411|lt=Oda Nobunaga}}, {{ill|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|en|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|qid=Q187550|lt=Toyotomi Hideyoshi}}, and {{ill|Tokugawa Ieyasu|en|Tokugawa Ieyasu|qid=Q171977|lt=Tokugawa Ieyasu}}. He played a significant role in the {{ill|calendar reform debates of the Tenshō period|ja|天正の改暦}} and later became involved in the administrative and ritual duties of the {{ill|Tokugawa shogunate|ja|徳川幕府}}.

In {{ill|Bunroku|ckb|بونرۆکو|es|Bunroku|fa|بونروکو|fr|Ère Bunroku|ia|Bunroku|id|Bunroku|ja|文禄|ko|분로쿠|ru|Бунроку|simple|Bunroku|sr|Бунроку|sv|Bunroku|tr|Bunroku|uk|Бунроку|zh|文禄|zh_yue|文祿|qid=Q1373039|lt=Bunroku}} 4 (1595), Hisanaga was temporarily exiled to {{ill|Owari Province|en|Owari Province|qid=Q514506|lt=Owari Province}} due to his alleged involvement in political conflicts.

=== Later Life ===
He returned to Kyoto in {{ill|Keichō|en|Keichō|qid=Q1328185|lt=Keichō}} 5 (1600) and regained favor, continuing his work in the {{ill|Yin-Yang Bureau|ja|陰陽寮}}. His contributions to court and shogunate rituals, including those for imperial successions and shogunate ceremonies, solidified his legacy.

Hisanaga passed away on {{ill|February 24, 1625|ja|1625th year 2月24日}}.

== Family and Descendants ==
Hisanaga's descendants continued to play significant roles in the {{ill|Tsuchimikado clan|ja|土御門家|lt=Tsuchimikado family}} lineage and in other noble families. However, the direct male lineage of {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|Abe no Seimei|qid=Q1150151|lt=Abe no Seimei}} is believed to have ended.
